newsitem.title: USA: Sparta Q1 net income exceeds FY96 profit. [CORRECTED 22:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Sparta Q1 net income exceeds FY96 profit. [CORRECTED 22:50 GMT]

text.p: Sparta Foods Inc said Monday that its earnings for the fiscal first quarter ended December 31 exceeded results for all of last year.

Earlier, Sparta reported earnings for the first quarter ended December 31 of $111,100 (corrects from "$111.1 million") or $0.02 a share on 6.7 million shares outstanding, compared with a year-ago loss of $72,400 (corrects from "$72.4 million") or $0.02 a share on 4.1 million shares outstanding.

"Net income in the first quarter exceed the net income of our entire prior fiscal year," Joel Bachul, president, said in a statement. "This reflects the results of our efforts to return Sparta Foods to profitability and our continuing focus on strengthening our position in the retail market."
In fiscal 1996 it earned $105,307 (corrects from "$105.3 million") or $0.02 a share.
"We are very pleased with these results and are excited about the opportunities and prospects for the rest of the year," Bachul said.
Sparta Foods makes and distributes tortillas and related products.
